prompt:
Refine this SanForum mobile forum comp while preserving its portrait 390:844 frame and everything outside the category area. Keep the deep blue header, logo, navigation, existing colors, humanist sans type, recent-topic title/snippet rhythm, unread marker, standard “Neues Thema” button and all topic text exactly as shown.

Make the category finder genuinely compact and continuous with the page. Replace the three large rounded category cards and their colorful square icon tiles with three clean text rows separated by light horizontal rules, with the same category names and quiet right chevrons. Each row uses a small simple blue category marker, never a colored tile or gradient. Keep long German labels readable with natural wrapping. Remove the invented category totals completely. The finder should take substantially less vertical space while remaining just as easy to find as the recent discussions. Retain “Kategorien” and “Alle Kategorien” and the equally prominent top “Kategorien” and “Aktuell” navigation. Reflow the discussion section upward into the reclaimed space, preserving all its typography and content, so the first viewport includes the opening of additional topics below. Keep the small “Beispielansicht” labels marking synthetic topic metadata. This is a polished working Discourse interface, not a dashboard of cards.
initialPrompt:
Create a high-fidelity mobile Discourse forum overview for SanForum.at, edge to edge, crisp readable German UI text, portrait 390:844 viewport proportion at high resolution. No device, browser frame or surrounding scene. This is a working forum for Austria’s rescue-service community: visitors browse categories and catch up on discussions, with equal prominence for both.

Use the attached original logo as the unchanged header asset, preserving its proportions and white wordmark, on a contrasting deep-blue header. Include familiar menu, search and account controls. Below, give “Kategorien” and “Aktuell” equally clear access. Show a compact category finder with “Rettungsdienst & Krankentransport”, “Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildung”, and “Geräte, Fahrzeuge & Technik”. Then a continuous reading surface with recent topics “Nützliche Apps für den Dienst”, “NFS-Kurs Empfehlung”, and “Monitoring im Vergleich”. Add short neutral discussion snippets, category labels, unobtrusive author initials, realistic reply/time metadata, and one clearly marked “Ungelesen” state. Label synthetic metadata with a small “Beispielansicht”. Include a standard “Neues Thema” button and the beginning of further discussion at the lower edge.

The direction is Fachjournal: the clarity of professional correspondence translated into a modern working forum, never a newspaper facsimile. One humanist sans carries generous readable titles, calm snippets and subordinate metadata. Crisp white reading surfaces, deep navy text and blue section headings; preserve SanForum’s #3877E5 light-mode accent. The signature is an unmistakable title-and-snippet rhythm with clear category/author hierarchy and breathing room. Standard web controls, precise alignment, no marketing hero, oversized display type, photo avatars, decorative cards or invented claims.
